Mission Local reported that a male after-school worker at Everett Middle School was arrested by San Francisco police over alleged inappropriate contact with a student. The district said the school contacted police after receiving a report, and that the principal contacted parents and others at Everett. The story said the after-school program is run by Mission Graduates, but it was unclear whether the man was an employee or volunteer.

Story: https://missionlocal.org/2024/03/everett-afterschool-teacher-arrested-inappropriate-relationship-student/

Correction: A previous version said parents had not received communication immediately after the incident; it was updated to reflect that the principal did send an email soon after.
